parkedBy: coordinator, after five sclera cards did not converge
statement: Lid shadow on sclera needs a lid-attached, iris-sparing method.

attempts.failure: cause named as lid occlusion; no sweep row passed G1+G2 on both subjects; the shell greyed the whole sclera

attempts.method: lid-relative shell alpha with a limbus gate
attempts.failure: M1 and M2b past midpoint on both, but iris darkened past its noise floor and Aisha's sclera read grey-mauve

attempts.method: shell alpha zeroed over the iris in UV, strength scaled by lid occlusion
attempts.failure: iris and catch-light failures independent of the spare; the picked row had occlusion scaling off
verdict alpha_applied_shell_occludes_iris: per-vertex alpha is applied, so the darkening is the baked shell itself

attempts.method: hemisphere AO from the seated lids baked into each subject's sclera texture
attempts.failure: AO is symmetric around the eye opening, so the lower sclera darkened more than the upper; a texture-baked shadow also rotates with the globe under gaze

reopenCondition: a method whose shadow follows the lid, not the globe, and keeps iris colour and catch-light within their noise floors; a texture-baked directional shadow does not qualify
whyNotMarkdown: docs:drift-check refuses unregistered Markdown and registering a new doc regenerates the authority registry
